selection_note: Six deliberately selected teaching examples, not a complete or representative sample. Candidate labels are not confirmation.

objects.name: M60-UCD1
objects.distance_basis: Adopted host distance in Strader et al. 2013; not a Gaia parallax distance.
objects.provenance: Strader et al. 2013, The Densest Galaxy; ADS 2013ApJ...775L...6S; DOI 10.1088/2041-8205/775/1/L6. Canonical coordinate counterpart is NGVS-UCD753, Liu 2020, J/ApJS/250/17 table3 row 753; the original row lacks a Gaia ID. Teaching identification does not change that association.
objects.caveat: Known control, not a new discovery. Host background and nearby streaks need inspection; its 6.6 kpc projected separation is inside the current research search's inner exclusion.

objects.name: M59-UCD3
objects.distance_basis: Adopted host distance in Sandoval et al. 2015; not a Gaia parallax distance.
objects.provenance: Sandoval et al. 2015, Hiding in Plain Sight; ADS 2015ApJ...808L..32S; DOI 10.1088/2041-8205/808/1/L32. Original position Table 1: 12:42:11.05 +11:38:41.3.
objects.caveat: A compact image is not automatically unresolved. Compare source profiles with nearby stars and record uncertainty.

objects.name: Foreground comparison
objects.distance_basis: No extragalactic host distance assigned. Strong measured parallax and motion favor a foreground star; not a spectroscopic classification.
objects.provenance: ESA Gaia DR3; deliberately selected near M59 with G 17-19, BP-RP 1-2, parallax_over_error > 10, RUWE < 1.2, and total proper motion > 10 mas/year. Exact query in docs/teaching/source_checks.md.
objects.caveat: Not an unbiased control and not exactly matched in magnitude or color to either UCD. Epoch differences can shift a moving star relative to its Gaia J2016.0 position.

objects.name: M59cO
objects.distance_basis: M59 host-distance convention for this exercise, following Sandoval et al. 2015; not an independent distance for the object.
objects.provenance: Chilingarian & Mamon 2008; ADS 2008MNRAS.385L..83C; DOI 10.1111/j.1745-3933.2008.00438.x. Original name SDSS J124155.33+114003.7; discussed as transitional between UCD and compact elliptical systems.
objects.caveat: Position-only Gaia solution: missing parallax, motion, and RUWE are not zeros. Its physical class illustrates a boundary rather than a perfectly separated category.

objects.name: J124352.42+112534.2
objects.host: M60 region; association not established by this exercise
objects.distance_basis: Conditional M60 distance for a luminosity exercise only; membership is not established.
objects.provenance: Liu et al. 2015, ADS 2015ApJ...812...34L; DOI 10.1088/0004-637X/812/1/34; VizieR J/ApJ/812/34 table6.dat, exact original name. Also in the inherited Fahrion 2019 comparative compilation (2019A&A...625A..50F; DOI 10.1051/0004-6361/201834941). Original status labels differ; approved canonical state remains candidate with no approved confirmation evidence.
objects.caveat: Published candidate, not confirmed. Visual review supplies evidence for an instructor; it does not promote the source.
